versions.changelog:
Initial release: Fast and structured Kuaishou public data search & trend insights for content teams and marketers.

- Supports keyword-based Kuaishou video search, creator post retrieval, and video comment scraping with structured JSON output.
- Enables viral topic scouting, competitor monitoring, KOL filtering, sentiment analysis, and trend discovery.
- No login required; operates entirely on public Kuaishou data with high-volume batch capability (up to 10,000 records).
- Clear API token setup and input requirements, with robust error handling and routing by input type (keyword, video link, profile link).
- Designed for seamless integration into analysis and report-generation workflows.
